overloadMerges.note: Doc bug: the page's own second signature line ("SAX OPEN XML ELEMENT ARRAYS* (...attribNamesArray: Text; attribValuesArray: Text)") is not a real second overload of THIS command. Fetched developer.4d.com directly to confirm: the page's Description section states outright "Except for the support of arrays (see below), this command is identical to SAX OPEN XML ELEMENT. Please refer to the description of this command for more information about its operation." The italicized '*'-suffixed line is the ARRAYS page's own doc-site convention for cross-referencing that sibling command's signature inline for comparison -- it is NOT a second calling form of SAX OPEN XML ELEMENT ARRAYS itself, and the sibling command (developer.4d.com/docs/commands/sax-open-xml-element, confirmed separately) has its own real, differently-named params (attribName/attribValue, singular, no 's') already modeled at its own IR id (SAX-OPEN-XML-ELEMENT). The mechanical extraction mistakenly reused THIS command's own attribNamesArray/attribValuesArray param names for that cross-referenced line, producing a spurious second overload with a scalar Text/Text repeat-group that the real 4D compiler rejects ("Invalid constant type: Alphanumeric" -- there is no such calling form). Collapsed back to the single genuine array-based overload; user-confirmed as a doc bug (2026-09-07).
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Adds a new element, optionally passing one or more attribute-name/attribute-value pairs as parallel arrays (attribNamesArray a Text array, attribValuesArray a typed Array of text/date/number/boolean/picture elements). Identical to SAX OPEN XML ELEMENT except for this array support.

constraints: Identical to SAX OPEN XML ELEMENT except for array support; see that command for tag naming rules and element-closing behavior.
attribValuesArray accepts arrays of text, date, number, Boolean, or picture type; 4D performs the necessary conversions automatically, configurable via XML SET OPTIONS.
The attribNamesArray/attribValuesArray arrays must be created beforehand and operate as attribute/attribute-value pairs; as many pairs of arrays (and items per pair) as desired may be passed.

Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): SAX write document lifecycle: SAX OPEN XML ELEMENT (or the ARRAYS variant) opens an element -> SAX ADD XML ELEMENT VALUE adds its content while it remains open -> SAX CLOSE XML ELEMENT closes the most recently opened element (or the document itself is closed, which auto-closes any still-open elements).
